name: thesis-review
description: Auto-maintain the belief layer (W8 belief-maintenance loop). Three modes: (1) digest refresh (B4) — re-synthesize the supporting digest for developing theses that accumulated new claims, delta-triggered, digest only; (2) signal derivation (B5b) — derive a monitoring thesis's qualitative confirmation/invalidation/completion signals from its claims; (3) health pass (B5c) — re-assess a monitoring thesis's signals against the latest routed evidence + price context, surfacing a decision only on weakening/invalidation. None change thesis status (the cascade owns it). Use when asked to 'refresh thesis digests', 'derive signals', 'run the thesis-health pass', 'review monitoring theses', 'run thesis-review', or to process the digest/signal/health worklists.
